features.label: Grenada (France)
features.source: French Grenada before cession to Britain at the Treaty of Paris.

features.label: Dominica (France)
features.source: France claimed Dominica before Britain acquired it at the Treaty of Paris; the island's Kalinago population remained autonomous in much of the interior.

features.label: Saint Lucia (France)
features.source: French Saint Lucia before the Treaty of Paris.

features.label: Saint Vincent (France)
features.source: French Saint Vincent before Britain acquired the island at the Treaty of Paris.

features.label: New France
features.source: French North America before the Treaty of Paris, represented with the later Canadian parts as a broad modern-boundary approximation.

features.label: Louisiana (France)
features.source: The French colony west of the Mississippi, ceded to Spain by the Treaty of Paris.

features.label: French Guiana
features.source: French Guiana has remained French, apart from the short Portuguese occupation during the Napoleonic wars, which this map does not split out.

features.label: Saint-Domingue (France)
features.source: The richest colony in the Caribbean, lost to the Haitian Revolution.

features.label: Santo Domingo (France)
features.source: Ceded by Spain at Basel and retaken by Spain after the Napoleonic wars reached the island.

features.label: Louisiana (France)
features.source: Retroceded by Spain at San Ildefonso and sold to the United States three years later.

features.label: Falkland Islands (France)
features.source: France established Port Louis in 1764 and ceded it to Spain; this broad pre-1765 span keeps the islands visible at the map's 1750 baseline.
